commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
90+5' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle after Marc Bartra (Betis) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
90+2' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alejo Veliz (Espanyol) is coming onto the pitch as Urko Gonzalez cannot continue after picking up an injury.
90+1' 1 - 2 Goal! Antony (Betis) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the top left corner.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Alex Kral (Espanyol) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
87' A corner kick by Espanyol is thwarted by the well prepared Adrian (Betis).

87' Alex Kral (Espanyol) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. The linesman makes the right call and Espanyol will have a corner.
85' 1 - 1 Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Joan Garcia with a strike into the right side of the goal. He makes it 1:1.
83' The corner is swung in but Espanyol can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
83' Jofre (Espanyol) collects an inch-perfect pass and strikes the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked. Espanyol have been awarded a corner kick.
83' Espanyol failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
82' Jofre (Espanyol) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Espanyol win a corner kick.
82' Isco (Betis) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

82' Hector Bellerin (Betis) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Betis.
80' Manuel Pellegrini decides to make a substitution. Youssouf Sabaly will be replaced by Hector Bellerin (Betis).
80' Substitution. Cedric Bakambu (Betis) replaces Cucho Hernandez.
80' The flag goes up and the referee blows his whistle - another offside by Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol), who has already been caught several times today.

79' That didn't go as planned! Javi Puado (Espanyol) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the right side of the goal was too weak to get past Adrian, who easily kept it out.
78' Alex Kral (Espanyol) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
78' Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
77' The attendance for today's match is 29126.
75' Isco (Betis) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
74' Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
73' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to substitute Exposito and he is replaced by Fernando Calero (Espanyol).
73' Javi Puado (Espanyol) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
72' Antony (Betis) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is behind the touchline and Espanyol will take a throw-in.
71' Isco (Betis) launches a cross from the corner, but Joan Garcia is alert to thwart the effort.
71' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked. Betis have a corner.
71' Marc Bartra (Betis) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.

68' OFF THE POST! Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
67' The flag is raised and Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) is offside again, not for the first time today.
67' Antony (Betis) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the left side of the goal, but Joan Garcia is well positioned to make a comfortable save.

66' The flag is raised by the referee's assistant. Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) is repeatedly being caught offside. He's always hanging on the shoulder of the last man to try and get into a scoring position.
65' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jofre (Espanyol) replacing Antoniu Roca.
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alvaro Tejero will replace Omar El Hilali (Espanyol).
64' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Espanyol was in an offside position.

62' Antony (Betis) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Joan Garcia pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
62' The resulting corner from Isco (Betis) comes to nothing.
62' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) zig-zags his way into the box and fails to direct a shot inside the left post. The goalkeeper pulls off a miraculous stop. Corner kick. Betis will have an opportunity.
60' Substitution. Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) in, Jesus Rodriguez out.
59' Manuel Pellegrini prepares a substitution. William Carvalho is replaced by Isco (Betis).

58' Sergi Altimira (Betis) latches onto a pass and lets rip with a swerving shot from long range towards the top of the net. It's a difficult effort to deal with and Joan Garcia does well to punch it away.
57' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

57' Antony (Betis) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the bottom right corner, but is thwarted by a great save from Joan Garcia. Betis earn a corner.
56' Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) plays a through ball but overhits it.

55' William Carvalho (Betis) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner, but his effort goes narrowly wide of the right post. This should be a big warning for the defence. The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.
55' Betis force a corner. They send men into the box.

54' Sergi Altimira (Betis) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The ball is out of play and Betis manage to earn a corner.
52' Guillermo Cuadra shows the yellow card to Carlos Romero (Espanyol) for a heavy challenge.
51' One of the players from Espanyol times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
50' Javi Puado (Espanyol) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the left side of the goal. However, Adrian anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
50' Antony (Betis) sends a long ball in, but Joan Garcia comfortably gathers the ball.
49' Half-chance! Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) plays a pass into the box, but Joan Garcia reacts well to snuff out the attack.
48' William Carvalho (Betis) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
46' Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) brings an opponent down and Guillermo Cuadra interrupts the game.
46' Half-time substitution. Pol Lozano is replaced by Alex Kral (Espanyol).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Marc Bartra (Betis) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
45+1' William Carvalho (Betis) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
42' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) decides to have a shot at goal from the free kick, but it hits the defensive wall.
41' Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Guillermo Cuadra signals. Betis earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
40' A pass into the box finds Cucho Hernandez (Betis) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the left side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Joan Garcia denies him.
39' The Betis players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
38' Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
35' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) was quite harsh and Guillermo Cuadra didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

33' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
31' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Espanyol.
28' 1 - 0 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Pol Lozano finds Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:0.

26' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.
25' Exposito (Espanyol) hits a shot towards the bottom right corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Adrian.
24' Betis fail to score from a corner as Joan Garcia (Espanyol) leaps to collect the ball.

23' Sergi Altimira (Betis) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. Betis will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
22' The Betis players are exchanging some short passes.
21' Ricardo Rodriguez (Betis) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
19' Espanyol are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
17' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
15' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) commits a foul and Guillermo Cuadra immediately signals a free kick.
14' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Espanyol, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
12' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) sends a long ball in, but Adrian comfortably gathers the ball.
12' Javi Puado (Espanyol) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
9' Antony (Betis) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
8' A cross from a corner kick by Betis is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

7' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) hits an explosive shot from outside the penalty area and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Betis.
7' Adrian was forced into action to thwart Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol). He found himself some space after picking up a pass and unleashed a shot to the left post but couldn't beat the keeper.
6' Sergi Altimira (Betis) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
3' Betis control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' Chance! Exposito (Espanyol) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
